title: teucrium pumilum subsp. carolipaui
intro: Teucrium pumilum subsp. carolipaui, commonly known as the Spanish blue thyme, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Spanish blue thyme include its ability to act as an antiseptic, disinfectant, and expectorant, making it useful for treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
